title: Dirichlet--Neumann bracketing for nonlocal operators
summary: We establish Dirichlet--Neumann bracketing for the Dirichlet eigenvalues of $ψ(-Δ)$ on bounded Lipschitz domains, where $ψ$ is an arbitrary complete Bernstein function. The eigenvalues lie between $ψ$ applied to the corresponding Neumann and Dirichlet eigenvalues of the Laplacian. Both inequalities are strict whenever $ψ$ admits no meromorphic continuation to $\mathbb C \setminus \{0\}$. The proof uses quadratic forms, operator monotonicity, and an analysis of equality in resolvent comparisons.
